dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: He—Hello, how can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Ah, you're the Traveler. How do you do? This is the side gate, and few people pass this way... so you really did give me a fright there, ahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: This gate leads to the Tenshukaku, the residence of our Almighty Shogun, so please refrain from doing anything reckless here.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: You're here just in time. Today's an important day!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: That's right! I've been looking all over the place for clues, and I've finally determined the location of that band of Kairagi!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Today, I will redeem myself and take back my weapon!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: However, I mustn't make the same mistake as before. The Kairagi are numerous, and many of them are unscrupulous.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: As long as they swarm me and drain my stamina, I'll be put on the back foot, and the same thing will happen again...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Therefore, I want you to accompany me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: I was defeated by them last time because the Kairagi were able to use their numerical advantage and took turns in whittling away my stamina.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: After I ran out of energy, their leader challenged me to a duel.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: This time, I would like you to fend off the surrounding Kairagi while I challenge their leader directly.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: After I cut down that villain, I'll come and help you.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I am grateful for your assistance!

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: In short, I'll be leaving things to you.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Now then, let us not delay things. Let's head off.

choices.text: It sounds like I'll be taking on many of them at once...

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Without their numbers, those Kairagi are nothing more than a rabble.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I have faith in your skills. Even if they decide to rush at you all at once, I still believe they'll stand no chance against you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You think too highly of me...
